name: netdust-wp
description: 1.2.4: wp-plan-requirements retired — its requirements live in netdust-gates' WordPress pack; the project CLAUDE.md template, /wp-new-project, wp-testing, ntdst-patterns and the README route through netdust-gates, and tests/test-live-routing.sh fails if a live file names netdust-agent, harnessed-development or the retired skill, or sends the gate to a stack template; CLAUDE.md names where a new site comes from (new-site.sh → bedrock/stackedWP skeleton → netdust/wp-starter payload, the gate's single home). 1.2.3: CLAUDE.md names only what exists — entry is netdust-gates:policy, the WP plan requirements are its WordPress pack, the close is make gate; the netdust-agent routing and Class A–F vocabulary are gone. 1.2.2: wp-testing — after a deploy, bin/e2e.sh seeds by E2E_ENV (ddev locally, wp --ssh on a deployed environment) so make e2e env=staging runs the shake-outs' @e2e flows; @smoke needs no seeding. 1.2.1: wp-new-project.md speaks the seven-verb simple flow — feature/hotfix from production, no development branch. 1.2.0: the shake-out can log in. wp-testing carries the access recipe a plan's `## Shake-out access` cites: on DDEV a magic link from aaemnnosttv/wp-cli-login-command (`wp login create --url-only --expires=900`, the server plugin never in deploy.payload, `wp login invalidate` at teardown), a per-run application password for wire rows deleted by uuid, Playwright storageState under the already-gitignored tests/e2e/.auth/, and the credential never in git — gate-check --shakeout scans the manifest for it. bin/wp-upstream-skills.sh installs four WordPress/agent-skills at a pinned commit (d87ee69) with a bash test, and wp-security + wp-infra shrink from 332 to 247 lines to cite that upstream instead of restating it. references/wp-review-checklists.md is vendored from jorgerosal/wordpress-skills (8c96442, MIT) with keyed SEC-nn / MIG-nn items; netdust-agent's security-sentinel loads it on every WP dispatch. wp-plan-requirements gains Block 4 — the shake-out sections a WP plan owes, by check name — and Block 3 trades the per-task drift pre-check for the panel-hints rule; the 09-03 ruling in CLAUDE.md is re-dated 2026-09-06 to the shape the gate now enforces. 1.1.0: ntdst-yootheme v2 — the baseline yootheme module instead of a per-project source, yoo-lint (16 silent-trap codes against the installed parent), yoo-measure + yoo-recompile, yoo_layout.py + a section catalogue, workflow.md (the Figma → LESS → sections → assemble → measure loop), lessons by task; anchored on YOOtheme 5.0.43 with 5.0.41 as the CVE floor. Netdust WordPress plugin — WP discipline (security, database, bedrock-composer), WP reference (frontend, testing, infra), ntdst-core framework (architecture, data, patterns + four golden-path feature exemplars mined from real Stride/Rossi, yootheme), and WP commands (/wp-new-project, /scaffold-plugin, /setup-tests). Layers on netdust-devops (the branch flow, deploy gate/ledger, site.yml schema, /deploy) and netdust-core (memory conventions, server management, cross-domain skills); the coding policy, WP plan requirements and live hooks are netdust-gates. 1.0.0: teaches ntdst-core 5.2.0 — the v5 contract (three doors, retired list, traps), golden paths on the v5 doors, a drift reviewer that runs core's invariants live, and evals anchored on the 5.2.0 tag.
